Share your HSBC data securely with Open Banking
UK Open Banking is a regulated framework overseen by the Financial Conduct Authority. It lets you share your account information with authorised apps — without sharing your password.
Account names, sort codes, IBANs, and currency for your HSBC accounts
Current, available, and credit-limit balances across all authorised accounts in real time
Up to 90 days of debits and credits, merchant names, and transaction references
Scheduled recurring payment mandates you have set up on your HSBC accounts
Active direct-debit mandates and the most recent amounts collected on your accounts
Monthly statement summaries, opening and closing balances, and available PDF references
Your consent lasts up to 90 days. You can revoke it at any time from Settings → Manage consents.
This app is Account Information only (AISP). We have no permission to initiate payments or move money from your account.
You authenticate directly on HSBC's secure portal using Strong Customer Authentication (SCA). Your credentials never leave HSBC.
You can disconnect HSBC data sharing at any time from Settings → Manage consents, or directly from your HSBC app.
Regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority under the Payment Services Regulations 2017. Powered by UK Open Banking Read/Write API v4.0 (OBIE).
We ask HSBC to prepare a consent with the list of data categories. You are redirected to HSBC's secure portal to review and approve it — choosing which accounts to include.
You log in on HSBC's portal using your HSBC credentials and complete Strong Customer Authentication. Mifos Open Banking never sees your password at any point.
3. A secure token is returned to us
HSBC sends a short-lived access token back using FAPI 1.0 Advanced — a banking-grade security protocol. We use it to read the data you approved; it cannot move money.
You can revoke this access at any time from Settings → Manage consents, or directly from your HSBC app or HSBC online banking.
